withdrawn.run: the first run, 2026-07-31: a SINGLE run of each arm
withdrawn.reason: This is the machine record of the first run, and its two headline ratios are REFUTED rather than merely out of date. The benchmark was re-measured on 2026-09-19 at three replicates of each arm, and both ratios below sit ABOVE every replicate on both clocks -- so they are not a noisy reading of the same quantity. The current figures are in results/RESULTS.md and the per-replicate rows are in RUN-RECORD.md.
withdrawn.see: RESULTS-2026-07-31-SUPERSEDED.md, which keeps the first run's document whole and unedited
withdrawn.quotation_status: frozen -- the 1.45 and 3.89 speedup values below are the WITHDRAWN readings. They are kept, not deleted, because a withdrawn machine record is the evidence of what was withdrawn and deleting it would leave the supersession pointing at nothing. No document in this repository may cite either as a current figure.
withdrawn.why_this_block_exists: Until 2026-09-21 NOTHING in the tree distinguished this record from a live one. The README and the superseded document both say the derivation excludes it, but the FILE said nothing, so anything that later aggregated results/ would have folded it in and nobody could have traced it afterwards. A standing check for withdrawn figures found it, which is what that check is for.

equivalence.note: Identical hit sets are NOT expected: analyzed text fields tokenize dimension values, so the naive design matches a superset. The one-sided check is what makes the latency comparison meaningful.
